content:
Downloads a specific export chunk in JSON or CSV format.
Caution: This endpoint is available for use but is currently in beta. The response structure is subject
to change as we continue to enhance the data model.
Requires the Basic [16] user role or the ASSET_INVENTORY.CYBER_ASSET_MANAGEMENT.READ  and
AD.TOGGLE_AD.USE  custom role privileges. See Roles.
AUTHORIZATIONS:
cloud
PATH PARAMETERS
string
The unique identifier (UUID) of the export request for which you want to
download a chunk.
string
The specific chunk number to retrieve from the export request.
Note: For exports in CSV format, each chunk includes a header row.
